fact_text: After the Pahalgam attack on 2 Apr 2025 and the rise in India-Pakistan tension, the KSE-100 index fell sharply and Pakistan's stock market declined again.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How To Calculate Your Risk Profile | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-11)

fact_text: After the ceasefire announcement on 10 May 2025, the KSE-100 index recovered very quickly.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How To Calculate Your Risk Profile | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-11)

fact_text: The KSE-100 index reached a record high on 11 Jun 2025, according to the speaker.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How To Calculate Your Risk Profile | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-11)

fact_text: After the Iran-Israel war broke out in June 2025, the KSE-100 index fell sharply again and was at a low by 23 Jun 2025.
